What the app does

Silkline uses an AI model to suggest which spider is in your photo and how risky it may be to people. Results are estimates and can be wrong. They are general information and are not medical advice.

Bites and emergencies

If you are bitten and feel unwell, or you are unsure, contact a doctor, your local poison centre or emergency services. Never rely on the app to decide whether a bite or a spider is safe.
